svg.aria-label: Overworld trailer: a world generates and the OVERWORLD logo is built block by block; then the command /overworld is typed in a Claude Code window and each of the ten biomes swaps in with a block wipe; then the Party pane slides in and agents spawn as mobs, a creeper blowing up; it ends on a hotbar of every biome and the install command.
svg.title: Overworld for Claude Code: trailer

g.text: Your Claude Code chat, in ten pixel biomes.

Cherry trees under a pink moon, lanterns and drifting petals.
A sunny morning in the plains, for the light mode people.
Giant trees, vines and bamboo, a mossy temple, a panda and a parrot.
Stars over the dunes, a temple, and a creeper near a cat.
Striped mesas at sunset, an old mineshaft and an armadillo.
Northern lights over the snowy taiga.
Sunbeams on the sea floor, a shipwreck and a glow squid.
End cities, crystal pillars and a dragon passing over.
A fortress bridge over lava, crimson fungi and a ghast.
An ancient city, soul lanterns and the warden. Shh.

Live tool, exact tokens, an XP bar. Creepers blow up.
